validity.operator_incident_notes: Lo mismo que en ocasiones pasadas al tocar planta no se detecta cambio perceptible
validity.data_after_timer_end: Retained in source recording, excluded from labelled phase comparisons

operator_environment.moisture_source: Direct operator observation; not a measured moisture value

verified_assignments.filt: g_plantSmoothV = feature.rms: ADC-window RMS used by the detector
verified_assignments.score: g_pilotDetector.amplitudeScore: absolute RMS-reference difference / RMS threshold
verified_assignments.occupancy: fraction of acquired ADC samples above zero
verified_assignments.transition_resets: Detector medium-transition recalibrations; not a board reboot counter

sensor_metric_semantics.scale: Nominal ADC conversion, not calibrated signed analogue voltage.
sensor_metric_semantics.other_firmware: Do not apply these assignments to EE5/EF5 without separately verifying their implementation.
sensor_metric_semantics.historical_reports: Earlier derived RMS labels referring to rms_mean describe arithmetic mean. Numerical raw readings are unchanged.

operator_audio: Black EB5 alone audible in all three repetitions; adding plant EC5 remains audible but no perceptible extra change; continuous sound and silence after releasing; no incidents reported.

data_quality.meaning: Flags missing host-received telemetry, including phase boundaries; does not prove a node reboot or missing analogue response.

interpretation: Contact with black EB5 causes NoteOns in all five nodes before plant EC5 contact. EC5 RMS/occupancy medians are zero in settled black-only and paired windows. EC5 keeps a MIDI note held throughout each paired window with zero additional EC5 NoteOns; sustained sound is not evidence of new local plant variation.
comparison_to_own_black: Same qualitative pattern as EC5 own-black-first trial: initial shared activation at black contact and no clear added plant effect. Baselines differ and trials are sequential; do not claim electrical equivalence or a causal difference between black cables.
limitations: Scheduled MIDI durations are not exact physical contact or audio durations.
Zero unsigned ADC summaries are not proof of zero signed analogue voltage or identical waveforms.
Contact with only two of five labelled black electrodes has been tested directly so far.
